aboutPreview.title: A small practice, built with care
aboutPreview.body: Victoria founded VM Integral Massage Inc. in 2021 — a Kissimmee studio for people who want skilled hands, a quiet room, and someone who listens.

aboutPage.title: Meet Victoria
aboutPage.tagline: A quiet room in Kissimmee, and care that takes its time.
aboutPage.experience: Victoria founded VM Integral Massage Inc. in 2021. We have more than 17 years of experience in therapeutic massage for many kinds of body pain. Our focus is your health, physical wellbeing, and quality of life.
aboutPage.commitment: We put you first: unhurried, integral massage, with the respect and care each person needs.
aboutPage.experts: We are also experts in lymphatic drainage massage.
aboutPage.mission1: We love this work, so we take time with it. We learn what your body needs, build trust, and shape each visit around your physical and emotional wellbeing.
aboutPage.mission2: That includes relaxation therapy, post-operative lymphatic drainage (with your surgeon’s approval), massage for injury recovery, and more. In every service, you can expect kind, professional, personal care.
aboutPage.mission3: Guests have given our massage therapy 5.0 stars on Google — a reflection of the care we try to give every visit.
aboutPage.galleryIntro: Photographs from the treatment room, including lymphatic drainage with pressotherapy.
aboutPage.resultsIntro: Before-and-after photographs of real post-operative recovery. Some images include clinical nudity, with the studio’s stickers already in place.

items.a: Message us on WhatsApp, call +1 407-388-4928, or email info@vmintegralmassage.com. We’ll confirm your appointment ourselves. There’s no online checkout yet.
211 Broadway, Kissimmee, FL 34741. Monday–Friday 8:00am–6:00pm, Saturday 8:00am–2:00pm, Sunday closed.
Sessions start at $110 for 60 minutes, $155 for 90 minutes, and $200 for 120 minutes. New clients pay $95 for the first 60-minute visit.
Yes — with your surgeon’s approval. We also offer packages of 5 sessions for $500 ($100 each) and 10 sessions for $900 ($90 each).
$99 a month includes one 60-minute therapeutic massage. Additional 60-minute sessions that month are $95. Unused sessions roll over for up to 90 days.

items.q: Can I buy a gift card?
items.a: Yes. Digital and physical gift cards are available at the same prices as our services, and must be used within 60 days of purchase.
We accept Zelle, credit or debit card, and cash. Tips are welcome.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.intro: VM Integral Massage Inc. is a local massage studio. This page explains how we handle the information you send when you book.
privacyPage.body1: Appointments are requested by WhatsApp, phone, or email. We use the name, phone number, and message you send only to answer you and to schedule your visit.
privacyPage.body2: This website has no accounts and no booking database. Choosing English or Spanish simply opens the matching pages.
